name: captain-finance-wlt
objective: Close all Captain financial journeys on WLT-owned truth: Cash-In, wallet, financial eligibility, COD, earnings/commissions, payout and reconciliation, with no parallel monetary model.
truthOwner: WLT exclusively owns Captain monetary truth, financial eligibility, ledger effects, Cash-In, COD financial effects, earnings/commissions, payout and reconciliation.

tasks.objective: Converge Captain finance presentation and Cash-In reachability
tasks.currentProblem: Stale finance presentation can contradict the primary screen and the required Captain top-up consumer is unproven.
tasks.requiredChange: Census account-finance/support finance/bridge/top-up callers; migrate every live path to current WLT-backed components, delete proven dead stale presentation, and if no Captain top-up entry exists add the smallest WLT session/authorize/capture consumer with canonical unknown/success readback.
tasks.targetState: One coherent Captain finance surface exists and required Cash-In reaches the existing WLT engine without a second monetary authority.
tasks.action: Trace every Captain finance entry and top-up consumer, converge live paths, remove stale bridge residue, implement only a missing WLT-backed consumer, then test actor/idempotency/unknown-result behavior.
mustNotChange: No second payment engine in DSH/frontend.
Unknown provider outcome is not success.
acceptanceCriteria: Reachable Captain top-up exists through WLT.
Capture/credit is exactly-once/atomic per governed semantics.
Stale contradictory bridge presentation is migrated or removed.
All finance entries resolve to WLT-backed truth.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused Captain surface adapters while preserving immutable WLT ledger/provider/reconciliation history.

tasks.objective: Enforce one COD effect and governed earnings/payout/reconciliation
tasks.currentProblem: Funded COD and collect/remit semantics could double-account the same order value if model selection is implicit.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace order payment/COD model selection into WLT reserve/collect/remit/release/finalize; remove or gate overlapping legacy semantics; test concurrent/replayed/cancel/finalize paths, WLT-derived earnings, read-only official payout destination, FULL_AVAILABLE/SPECIFIED and provider unknown outcomes; reconcile ledger/audit/operator readback.
tasks.targetState: Each order produces exactly one authorized monetary effect and payout/earnings remain WLT-derived, duplicate-safe and reconcilable.
tasks.action: Map all COD writers/effects, enforce explicit mutually exclusive model selection, execute concurrency/cancellation/retry/provider scenarios and reconcile ledger/audit/readback.
mustNotChange: No duplicate funded plus remittance effect for one order value.
Frontend/DSH do not own monetary arithmetic.
Beneficiary cannot mutate official payout destination master data.
Unknown provider outcome remains reconcilable, not completed.
acceptanceCriteria: COD model selection is explicit/mutually exclusive.
Cancel/finalize/replay post exactly one legal effect.
Earnings/payout are WLT-derived and actor isolated.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused adapters/policy only while preserving immutable monetary history and never reopening duplicate financial paths.
tasks.commitBoundary: Focused COD/payout state-model commit with ledger/provider evidence.
